welcome:
`gYou step into the imposing, silent church. The little light falls through the stained-glass windows onto the altar. There is a scent of incense.`w

"Kneel down, traveler," whispers a monk in a long robe. "Say a prayer to the Gods of the Realm. But be warned... the Gods are fickle!"
bless_gold: `2The heavens open and a warm beam of light touches you! You find {gold} gold pieces on the altar!`w
bless_gems: `2An angel descends and grants you a shiny Gem ({gems} Gem)!`w
bless_heal: `2A divine power flows through your veins. All your wounds are healed in one blow!`w
bless_neutral: `gYou pray fervently to the Gods... but nothing happens. The silence in the church remains undisturbed.`w
curse_hp: `4The sky darkens and a fierce bolt of lightning strikes right before your feet! You lose {hp} HP from the shock!`w
curse_gold: `4A sudden gust of wind rushes through the church and secretly blows {gold} gold pieces out of your pouch!`w
confess_welcome: You kneel down in the small wooden confessional. 'Speak, my child. What weighs on your heart?' the monk whispers from behind the hatch.
candle_welcome: The altar of the Old Gods is bathed in the light of dozens of candles. Each flame stands for a hope, a wish, or a memory.
